_comment: Skip reasons a suite run may report, and how many of each. Do not add an entry to make a red run green: name the prerequisite, say why the skip is acceptable, and cite the run that showed it. A reason outside this list fails the session (conftest.py, tests/skip_budget.py).

reasons.why: One slider-update test skips where Tk's scale widget cannot be driven; the run's display report states whether GUI behaviour was verified at all, so this is not a blanket headless skip.
Windows without the symlink privilege cannot create the link the case needs. CI's runners hold the privilege and run it, so the budget admits one on a developer host and zero here.
A chmod-based check has no Windows equivalent; the test asserts nothing else, so it skips on every Windows host including CI.

CI installs ffmpeg through chocolatey, and gyan.dev's essentials build omits --enable-libsoxr, so the three resampler-quality cases cannot configure aresample=resampler=soxr there. A developer build with libsoxr runs all three.
